title: THE GHOST
description: A broker named GHOST hides behind a relay chain. Reach GHOSTNET and earn their trust.
goal: Route to GHOSTNET, solve the vault riddle and retrieve the ledger.
hint: GHOSTNET has no direct route: type 'route ghostnet' or just 'connect ghostnet'.
story_start: GHOST: "You found me. Good. Not many do. The road to my door is a maze of relays — pick the quiet ones."
GHOST: "My vault asks for a code. I like riddles."

objectives.text: Build a relay route to GHOSTNET
objectives.hint: Click the nodes to build a path from YOU to GHOSTNET. Keep risk low!
login ghost — then solve the access code puzzle using the clues.

choice.prompt: GHOST: "Now that you've seen my ledger — what do you want to do with what you know about the fourteen?"

options.text: Share everything with GHOST. Two heads are better than one.
options.result: GHOST nods once. "Partners, then. Don't make me regret it."

options.text: Keep it to yourself. Trust nobody yet.
Tell MIRA about GHOST. She is your handler, after all.
options.result: GHOST's channel flickers. "...I see. Well. That's a choice."

story_end: The ledger contains a credential that belongs to nobody. GHOST calls it 'a gift'. You suspect it is a leash.

messages.text: Someone is tunnelling into BLACKVAULT from outside. Find where the intruder came from: RELAY-7. Mission 005.
